title: Consolidate the six ad-hoc mkdir locks onto lib/dir-lock.js
body: S3b-1 extracted the hardened advisory lock (owner token, heartbeat, stale reclaim, ABA-safe release AND ABA-safe reclaim) to lib/dir-lock.js, but only wired the fluid layer to it. Five copies remain in lib/ and they do NOT agree: the weakest sets its stale threshold equal to its acquire timeout, so ordinary contention is indistinguishable from a crashed holder and a busy lock gets stolen from a live owner. judgment-writer.js also still has the pre-fix reclaim race.
